title: Acknowledge Message
help: Acknowledge a message received by the inbound endpoint (target INBOUND, the default) or a message polled with ackMode CLIENT (target POLL). The inbound endpoint must run with solace.autoAck=false. The settlement outcomes are negotiated with the broker by the inbound endpoint.

value.name: target
value.helpTip: INBOUND settles the inbound endpoint's message through its settlement handle. POLL settles the message stashed by a poll with ackMode=CLIENT.

value.name: responseVariable
value.helpTip: Property name where the operation result is stored.

value.name: overwriteBody
value.helpTip: Replace the Message Body in Message Context with the response of the operation.
